description: The craft of building a change, for whoever builds it: a developer, or a lead that builds its own spec. Skills only, with no inject: the builder's role says when to use them. How to run the work and its extra worktrees, writing it test first, diagnosing a bug before fixing it and designing as it writes, proving it works, iterating with a fresh reviewer each round (a new code-reviewer instance, this template's soul, spawned as an OATS child on a different model where one is available) until a round finds nothing to fix, working the PR's reviews, and keeping the development docs current. Copied from the engineering template, template-v2.2.0.
